data.exact_reserve_text: During 2023 the Syndicate released $89.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2022: $85.9m), arising predominantly from the Casualty, Marine and Treaty divisions (2022: predominantly from the Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2023.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate closed 2023 with a gross claims outstanding opening balance of $3,372.9m and recorded a gross release of technical reserves of $89.2m in respect of prior years (a c.2.6% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding). The release arose predominantly from favourable claims development in the Casualty, Marine and Treaty divisions. Prior-year exposures remain, notably to the Russia/Ukraine crisis, Covid-19 related losses and Hurricane Ian, which are disclosed with quantified gross and net estimates in the technical reserves note.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2023 the Syndicate released $89.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2022: $85.9m), arising predominantly from the Casualty, Marine and Treaty divisions (2022: predominantly from the Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions).
These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2023.
The Syndicate has material exposure to claims arising from the Russia and Ukraine crisis that arose when Russia invaded Ukraine towards the end of February 2022.
The Syndicate also has exposure to losses emanating from the Covid-19 pandemic and the ensuing Global Economic Crisis.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the native currency of the accounts (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities: claims outstanding) 2022 comparative column. Prior year development sourced from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which explicitly states a $89.2m release (gross) - confidence high. Reserve movements are not quantified by individual LOBs in the note, so per-LOB amounts are null. Claims development triangle is presented on page 34 (gross) and was not used to recompute prior year development because an explicit gross prior-year movement is provided. Some named events are described without quantified impacts; confidence for those is reduced accordingly.
